scope: Production native desktop UI source, with relevant inline and integration tests

fixes.before: Loop submission, sidebar changes and permission rules could mutate local state after dispatch failed.
fixes.after: Drafts and forms remain retryable; archive, undo, pin and rename update after accepted dispatch.
fixes.why: Avoids losing user input and showing changes that were never sent.

fixes.before: Failed dispatch could hide an approval and keyboard shortcuts could decide unseen approvals in older history.
fixes.after: Failed decisions remain retryable; allow, deny and Escape require the latest history for pending approvals.
fixes.why: Preserves informed decisions without changing ordinary task stopping.

fixes.before: Thinking deltas repeatedly rebuilt strings and completed answers without tools lost their reasoning disclosure.
fixes.after: Reasoning uses the stream buffer, reuses snapshots and remains available after completion.
fixes.why: Reduces repeated work and preserves readable context.

fixes.before: Old extension refreshes and plugin runs could replace newer query or project state.
fixes.after: Search uses current filters and plugin output is bound to its module and workspace epoch.
fixes.why: Keeps results attached to the request that produced them.

fixes.before: Initial load failures could leave skeletons running; empty memory views hid failures; asset receipts could overlap.
fixes.after: Failures expose retry controls, archive access remains available and asset actions are single-flight.
fixes.why: Makes failed operations understandable and recoverable.

fixes.before: Discarded recovery reopened stale source state and failed page ranges left cells indefinitely loading.
fixes.after: Discard adopts the current source and failed ranges mark all affected cells.
fixes.why: Prevents obsolete conflict state and false loading indicators.

fixes.before: Clearing project search could clear file conflicts and pending reads; stopping could retain pagination.
fixes.after: Result resets preserve editor state and explicit Stop clears continuation.
fixes.why: Protects overwrite warnings and respects cancellation.

fixes.before: Search dismissal and terminal question dismissal lost focus; root quit did not reliably reach the unsaved-file guard.
fixes.after: Focus returns to its originating control; root, shell and native menu share one guarded quit action with its platform accelerator. The duplicate startup binding is removed.
fixes.why: Keeps keyboard workflows predictable and protects unsaved work.

fixes.before: Canonical workspace paths could duplicate projects or lose saved panels; stacked file splitters used side-by-side geometry.
fixes.after: Aliases reconcile to one project with saved preferences and splitters use the rendered pane origin.
fixes.why: Preserves workspace state and makes dragging track the pointer.

fixes.before: Removal eligibility could become stale while confirmation was open.
fixes.after: Active checkout and terminal use are rechecked immediately before removal.
fixes.why: Avoids removing worktrees that became active during confirmation.

fixes.before: Several controls lacked explicit labels and long command titles could consume the output dialog.
fixes.after: Question choices, permission patterns, MCP and document fields have explicit labels; output titles have a bounded height.
fixes.why: Improves assistive navigation and keeps output controls visible.

fixes.before: Runtime icons used a separate procedural drawing from packaged artwork.
fixes.after: Packaged, Dock, X11 and tray icons derive from the canonical PNG; macOS extracts its alpha template before resizing.
fixes.why: Keeps mark geometry and padding consistent across icon sizes.

fixes.before: Environment setup referred to this Mac on every platform and could select an unavailable container engine.
fixes.after: Copy refers to this computer and uses an available Docker or Podman engine.
fixes.why: Matches the actual platform and available tools.

fixes.before: Invisible user-message actions reserved a separate row, making a short user message 84 pixels tall; answer action gaps were 54 pixels.
fixes.after: User controls share the bubble row, giving a 40 pixel short message; answer controls use a 36 pixel gap.
fixes.why: Removes unused vertical space while retaining contained controls, pointer hover transfer and keyboard focus at wide and narrow split widths.

validation.shared_fixture_note: Native harness counts include the three shared terminal fixture tests in each executable.
validation.ignored_test: native_editor_completion_uses_real_host_and_clangd requires native clangd for OS qualification; clangd is not available on PATH on this host.
fixture_corrections: Memory fixture startup readiness and exact destination checks before SQLite contention

application_build.command: cargo build -p xylo -p xylo-worker -p xylo-helper -p xylo-cli --locked --no-default-features -j 2
application_build.kind: Development build without the optional bundled browser download

manual_windows_checks: Light and dark appearance and header alignment
Window logo and in-app mark alignment
Ctrl+K opens search with keyboard focus
Escape closes search and restores composer focus
Ctrl+Q with the composer focused closes the final rebuilt app
Relaunch succeeds with the isolated preview profile

rc6_followup.native_close: Windows and Linux close now reaches the existing guarded quit flow; macOS with a tray preserves hide behavior.
rc6_followup.unfocused_quit: Quit binds globally and defers the shell action until GPUI restores its borrowed window. Real unfocused Providers/save/Cancel regression failed before the fix and passes afterward.
rc6_followup.windows_taskbar: Sequential captures of the same executable showed a generic icon with the old installed release identity and the purple logo with an isolated identity. Windows debug builds now use com.qurkos.xylo.dev; release keeps com.qurkos.xylo.
rc6_followup.provider_editor_notice: A real OpenAPI import followed by switching to OpenAI reproduced a stale success notice. Resetting provider discovery now clears that notice.
rc6_followup.installer_icon: Canonical PNG-derived ICO supplied to NSIS; exact-byte drift regression passes.
release_pipeline_repairs: Move the runtime wire test module after other items for strict Clippy.
Allocate the streaming checksum buffer on the heap; subprocess regression passes with a 128 KiB stack.
rc6_followup.strict_desktop_clippy: Passed with --no-default-features --no-deps; existing Windows dependency warnings remain outside this check.

rc7_followup.reason: CI functional checks passed on macOS, but dependency audit rejected calamine 0.37.0 under RUSTSEC-2026-0436.
rc7_followup.additional_guard: A CFB-prefix/ZIP polyglot passed archive preflight and caused a calamine 0.38.0 panic. XLSX/XLSM/XLSB readers now reject that compound-file wrapper before the encryption probe. Legacy XLS and ODS paths are unchanged.

validation_portability: Native input tests use the platform Select All chord.
Work-pane lifecycle tests inspect the pane and selected tab.
Rendering reports identify the actual OS.
The memory fixture waits for initial setup and scoped drafts before database contention and verifies the exact project after each switch.
